basic_details.job_title: DLSA Dumka Member, PLA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The Member shall hold office for a term of 5 years or till the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier. Not specified in the notification regarding minimum age limits.

qualification.details: Candidate must not have been convicted in any criminal case, and must not have any criminal case pending against them.

salary_details.pay_scale: Sitting fee of Rs. 2500/- per sitting and Conveyance allowance as per rules

how_to_apply: Visit the official website of Civil Court, Dumka at dumka.dcourts.gov.in to download the application format.
Print the application form and fill in all required details such as applicant name, father's name, DOB, address, contact number, and email address.
Affix one recent passport size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Attach copies of educational qualifications, experience, and work profile certificates.
Enclose two self addressed stamped envelopes (Rs. 55/- each) with the application.
Address the application to the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Dumka.
Send the completed application by Speed Post/Courier so that it reaches latest by 10.11.2026 by 5 PM.
important_instructions: Applicants must have adequate experience in public utility services as specified in the notification. Candidates must mention whether they have been convicted in any criminal case or if any criminal case is pending against them (Yes/No). Applications must be accompanied by ONE recent passport size photograph affixed on the application form. Two self addressed stamped envelopes (Rs. 55/- each) must be attached with the application. Applications must reach the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Dumka by Speed Post/Courier latest by 10.11.2026 by 5 PM. Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Dumka Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Member in Permanent Lok Adalat (PLA), Dumka.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Dumka Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidate must not have been convicted in any criminal case, and must not have any criminal case pending against them.

rows.qualification_required: Persons having adequate experience in public utility services (transport service for the carriage of passengers or goods by air, road or water; or postal telegraph or telephone service; or supply of power, light or water to the public by any establishment; or system of public conservancy or sanitation; or service in hospital or dispensary; or insurance service; or banking service; or education or educational institutions; or housing and real estate services).

faq.question: Q1. What is DLSA Dumka Member, PLA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the District Legal Services Authority, Dumka to fill 1 post of Member in the Permanent Lok Adalat (PLA).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DLSA Dumka Notification 01/2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Member, PLA post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by Speed Post/Courier is 10 November 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA?
faq.answer: Applicants must have adequate experience in public utility services such as transport, postal, telegraph, telephone, power, water supply, conservancy, sanitation, hospital, insurance, banking, education, housing, or real estate services.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit or tenure for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA?
faq.answer: The Member shall hold office for a term of 5 years or till the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q6. What is the sitting fee for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are entitled to a sitting fee of Rs. 2,500 per sitting along with conveyance allowance as per Permanent Lok Adalat amendment rules, 2025.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for DLSA Dumka Member, PLA Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format from the official website dumka.dcourts.gov.in, fill it out, attach a photograph, two self-addressed stamped envelopes (Rs. 55 each), and relevant certificates, and send it by Speed Post/Courier to the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Dumka.
